head: 37ecb4da90cd1fd8d007a869117043708dc4ad8c
claim: A fresh consumer installs the shipped accounts package, links a ChatGPT account by device code, reads its status, and gets an answer

steps.start: a fresh consumer app with no package installed and no account linked
steps: install the shipped @byokit/accounts package into the app
the app links a ChatGPT account by device code: it shows a code and the person approves it
the app reads the account status
the app asks the provider a question and prints the answer it gets back
steps.result: the installed package answers: "ChatGPT is connected." and the answer "You said: Plan my day"

verdicts.seen: I read the full capture, which has 7 lines. It shows the package as @byokit/accounts@0.34.0, sign-in waiting with code MOCK-10001, 'status: ChatGPT is connected.', and 'streamed: You said: Plan my day' with a matching 'answer: You said: Plan my day'. Together these show the outcome: the package was installed, the account was linked, status was read, and an answer was returned. The 'not offered' and 'no account' lines are expected negative checks, not contradictions. The outcome names one part, so parts and covers are empty.
